data.title: Preview: Senegal vs Sudan - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
Habib Diarra, Ismaila Sarr and Abdallah Sima are also unavailable, which leaves Nicolas Jackson, Mbaye, Ndiaye and Boulaye Dia as the main attacking options.

With Jakobs retired, El Hadji Malick Diouf is the left-back option, and Kalidou Koulibaly captains a back line that also includes Moussa Niakhate.

For the visitors, no injury or suspension has been reported ahead of the trip to Dakar. [...] Mohamed Eisa and Yasin Hamed have found the back of the net from the spot against Ethiopia and Mozambique respectively, and will hope to get a goal from open play against Senegal.

Senegal possible starting lineup:

Diaw; Sy, Koulibaly, Niakhate, El Hadji Malick Diouf; Pape Gueye, Camara; Mbaye, Pape Matar Sarr, Ndiaye; Jackson

Sudan possible starting lineup:

Mustafa; Barglan, Tabanja, Karshoum, Kuku; Taifour, Abdalla, Khedr; Aamir Abdallah, Muzmel, M. Eisa [...] Several of Appiah's players come from Al Hilal and Al Merrikh, and the return leg against Senegal follows on Monday, November 16.

data.title: Senegal vs Sudan Prediction and Betting Tips | November 12th 2026
data.content:
Senegal have world-class attacking depth thanks to players like Nicolas Jackson, who will test Sudan's defensive capabilities. Sadio Mane is not available for this international window due to personal reasons. The Teranga Lions are expected to dominate possession and use overlapping wingers to keep Sudan under pressure. As the visiting side, Sudan will likely deploy a compact defensive low block, as they aim to absorb pressure and hit swiftly on the counterattack.

Ad [...] Senegal have dominated this fixture, with Sudan yet to beat the Teranga Lions in an international match.
 Senegal have beaten Sudan five times, while two matches have ended all square. Senegal have scored 13 goals in this fixture, while Sudan have netted only three times.
 The most recent meeting ended 3-1 to Senegal in the round of 16 of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations. [...] The Falcons of Jediane have managed only two goals in their two qualifiers thus far, and they will need to be far more clinical to trouble Senegal in this match.

Head coach James Kwesi Appiah will look at this double-header as a great opportunity to leapfrog their illustrious rivals in the qualifying group, and with the top two teams in Group J set to qualify for the 2027 AFCON, there are some valuable points up for grabs in this international window.

data.title: Junior Bright Stars to face Senegal in crucial AFCON U23 qualifier in Juba
data.content:
The team won the first leg 3–0 before losing 2–1 in the return match. However, the result gave South Sudan a 4–2 aggregate victory, allowing the team to progress to the next round.

Tomorrow’s match is expected to be a tough test for the South Sudanese side against Senegal, one of the West African teams with experience in continental football.

The Bright Young Stars will, however, be hoping to use home advantage and support from local fans to secure a good result ahead of the return fixture. [...] South Sudan’s U23 national football team will face Senegal U23 tomorrow in the first leg of the 2026 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) U23 qualifiers at Juba National Stadium.

The Bright Young Stars have been preparing for the match as they seek to secure a positive result at home before travelling for the return leg.

South Sudan booked its place in this round after eliminating Djibouti U23 in the previous qualifying stage. [...] The match between South Sudan U23 and Senegal U23 will kick off at 3:00 PM tomorrow at Juba National Stadium.

The encounter offers South Sudan another opportunity to move closer to qualification for the 2026 AFCON U23 tournament.
